title: Ragaa Ibiddaa
intro: Namni dhuunfaa gadi fagoo, dhugaa isa dhumaa saaxiluudhaaf of kenne, imala argannoo hafuuraa jalqabe. Amantiin isaanii kan hin raafamne, qorumsa guddaa daangaa amantii qoratu akka isaan mudatu, seera hundeeffame akka morman isaan taasiseera. Seenaan lubbuu kanaa eegumsaa fi qajeelfama waaqummaaf ragaadha.
clues: Maqaa addaa Gooftaa koo irraa argadheen eebbifame, kunis hidhata gadi fagoo fi addaa kan agarsiisudha.
Jireenyi koo inni jalqabaa namoota fakkiiwwan harkaan hojjetamanitti jilbeenfatan gidduutti kan dabarse siʼa taʼu, garaan koo garuu Waaqa Dhugaa Tokkicha hawwe.
Qaamolee samii, aduu, ji’aa fi urjiilee, ka’uu fi kufaatii isaanii xiinxalee, Gooftaa koo ta’uu akka hin dandeenye xumuree ilaale.
Gocha shirkii bal’inaan babal’ate mormuudhaan, waaqolii sobaa wajjin wal dura dhaabbadhee, kan kophaa ta’ee fi guddaa ta’e akka nama callisee himatutti akka hin tuqamne dhiise.
Waaqeffannaa waaqa tolfamaa irratti qormaanni ani godhe adabbii cimaa natti fide, sababiin isaas gara ibiddaa dheekkamsaatti akkan darbatamu natti murtaaʼe.
Ta’us ajaja Uumaa kootiin abiddi cimaan sun gara madda qabbanaa’aa fi nageenyaatti jijjiiramee lubbuu koo eegeera.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
